reference.authority: Rev publisher nlp_references, independent human verbatim text according to the authors paper

prospectiveNormalization.purpose: Lexical diagnostic only; must be fixed before reading a model hypothesis
rules: Use token column, not named-entity normalization/equivalence sidecars
Keep fillers, repeated tokens, numbers, interior apostrophes and false-start hyphens; no synonym or number equivalence
Do not collapse uh and um or delete either token
Both reference and hypothesis must use the same frozen tokenizer; unavailable/ambiguous tokens remain explicitly reported

rights.audioLicense: No matching blanket audio CC grant in the inspected license; authors paper cites fair-use rationale

pretraining.localHeldOut: Not used in this project’s accepted personal-source experiments

unsupportedPrerequisites: Exact text-complete <=60s source interval for the named eight-token utterance and surrounding context
Applicable audio use/redistribution authority beyond the publisher rationale
Evidence excluding this source from selected Parakeet pretraining, if that stronger held-out claim is required
scope: No audio download, inference, new model, capture, playback, human annotation task, or repository edits; independently manual word-edge gold remains absent
